about: Comox is a town on Vancouver Island’s east coast in the Comox Valley, on the shores of Comox Harbour facing the Beaufort Mountains and Strait of Georgia. A marina, downtown streets, and nearby CFB Comox shape a coastal valley community distinct from Courtenay next door. About 15,000 people live in Comox.
seoSummary: Comox Valley harbour town on Vancouver Island—marina, downtown, and coastal mountain views.
knownFor: Views to the Beauforts and Strait of Georgia
